prose.name: Recovery: Family Compass on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders hit a freighter carrying a family's belongings to <SecondPlace> and took the hold to the <Place>. The family only wants one thing back: a brass compass that came from Earth.
prose.card: Raiders took the hold of a freighter carrying our belongings, and are holding it at the <Place> on <Planet>. Keep whatever else you find. We want one thing back, a brass compass. Return it to us in <SecondPlace>. Payment on contract completion.

beats._at: The medium marker, not the boss marker: a boss-marker site is almost always a military dungeon and the quest starts only where one is close (32a, his 'there is a cap on the complexity of locations').
beats.objective: Defeat the raiders' leader at the <Place>
beats.journal: The raiders' leader at the <Place> is dead. The family's compass will be with whatever they took off the freighter.
say: If they're dealt with, it'll be in with everything they took off us. Please look carefully, it's small.

beats.objective: Find the compass in the raiders' takings
beats.journal: I found the family's brass compass in the raiders' takings at the <Place>. It goes back to them in <SecondPlace>.
beats.name: Raiders' Takings
beats._model: The footlocker, approved (objects.md) and his own pick for a chest in the open. Here it is what it looks like: where raiders keep what they took.

message.title: Brass Compass
message.text: Under someone's good shoes and a box of cutlery, wrapped in a sock: a brass compass, worn smooth on one side where a thumb has rested on it for a very long time.

beats._at: 2026-10-23 (Eliza): New Atlantis's one AutofillGeneric01 spot (133415), city01a's shape after his 'lets just go for autofill 01 and see' for Akila. The lint refused RECenterLocRef here: no city carries a POI marker. Whether the spot reads as where a family that just moved in lives is his eye.
beats.objective: Return the compass to the family in <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: Raiders took a family's belongings to the <Place>. I went in and brought back the one thing they wanted, a brass compass their great-grandmother carried from Earth.

person.name: Nell Ashby
hellos: We've only just moved in, so everything's still in boxes.

greeting: The raiders who hit our freighter took everything we own. Did they still have the compass?

reply: That's it. That's the dent from when my mother dropped it on a landing pad. I'd stopped telling the children it would come back.

exchanges.prompt: Why this and not the rest?
reply: The rest was furniture. You can buy furniture. This came from Earth. My grandmother's grandmother carried it on one of the first ships out, and it's been in somebody's pocket ever since.
It points north. Which north, on a planet that isn't Earth, nobody in this family has ever agreed on.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 is the hand-over: it ends the talk, takes the Brass Compass and sets stage 100, which pays 'reward'. Every prompt stands on the greeting or what he carries (talk_check.py). Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency.

broadcast: You're nearly at the site. They'll have kept the compass with the rest of what they took. It's old and brass, and it's the only thing we want back.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site (arrivalStage 15). Same voice on the radio and in person: Lucy, 'Friendly, Relaxed, Thoughtful', used once (08a); his ear decides.
